stories.summary: Enable Submit to catalog only for a build Ready at its head SHA
Open a catalog pull request under the author's own source-control identity and record it on the build
Put the head-SHA readiness checks and the run and scan report links in the pull-request description
Track the pull request and build through open, submitted, merged and abandoned
Clear readiness when a submitted build is saved without closing its pull request
Never write directly to the catalog or the platform outside the catalog pull request
